index.title: Components
index.description: Every primitive in the astro-ignite registry, rendered live.

summary.button: Trigger actions. Supports variants and sizes.
summary.link: Inline navigation with default, muted and underline variants.
summary.text: Typography primitive — display, h1–h4, lead, body, small, muted, eyebrow, code.
summary.card: Surface container with header / content / footer slots.
summary.label: Accessible label for form controls.
summary.alert: Inline message block with semantic variants.
summary.dialog: Modal overlay built on the native <dialog> element.
summary.dropdown-menu: Anchored menu using the native popover API.
summary.toast: Transient notifications via a toaster surface.

button.description: Trigger actions. Renders a <button> by default, or an <a> when href is provided. Variants: default, secondary, outline, ghost, destructive, link. Sizes: sm, md, lg, icon.

link.description: Inline navigation. Renders an <a> with semantic colour variants.

text.description: Typography primitive that decouples style from semantic tag. Pick a visual variant (display, h1–h4, lead, body, small, muted, eyebrow, code) and optionally override the rendered tag with `as`. Use `tone` for default | muted | subtle colour.
text.displaySample: Astro sites, built for AI agents.
text.h1Sample: The full type scale, in one component.
text.leadSample: A larger paragraph for intros and ledes — sits between a heading and body copy.
text.bodySample: Body copy. Default size, optimised for long-form reading at comfortable line height.
text.smallSample: Smaller copy for captions, footnotes, and metadata.
text.mutedSample: Muted copy — same scale as small, dimmer colour for de-emphasis.

badge.description: Compact status indicator. Variants: default, secondary, outline, destructive, success, warning.

card.description: Surface container composed from card, card-header, card-title, card-description, card-content and card-footer.
card.title: Project insights
card.lede: The pulse of your team this week.
card.body: Throughput is up 12% over last week. No regressions detected in the last 24 hours.

input.description: Single-line text field. Forwards all standard <input> attributes.

textarea.description: Multi-line text field. Forwards all standard <textarea> attributes.

label.description: Accessible label for form controls. Use the for attribute to associate it with an input by id.

separator.description: Visual divider. orientation: horizontal (default) or vertical.

alert.description: Inline message block. Variants: default, destructive, warning, success.
alert.defaultBody: This is a default alert — useful for general information.
alert.destructiveBody: Could not reach the upstream server.

avatar.description: User image with text fallback. Sizes: sm, md, lg. Falls back to initials when no src is provided or the image fails to load.

skeleton.description: Loading placeholder. Size it freely with style attributes or utility classes.

kbd.description: Keyboard shortcut indicator. Renders a styled <kbd> element.

tabs.description: Tabbed content panels. Compose with tabs, tabs-list, tabs-trigger and tabs-content. Behaviour ships in a custom element — no framework needed.
tabs.tab1Body: Tabs let you swap related content in place without navigation.
tabs.tab2Body: Tabs ship pre-installed in both templates — copy the source from the registry to use it anywhere else.
tabs.tab3Body: Wrap triggers and content with matching value props inside a Tabs root.

accordion.description: Collapsible content sections built on the native <details> element. Each item takes a title prop and an open flag.
accordion.q1Body: A production-grade Astro scaffold with i18n, legal, analytics and a registry of primitives built in.
accordion.q2Title: How do I install a component?
accordion.q2Body: Components ship pre-installed in both templates at src/components/ui — yours to edit. To use one elsewhere, copy it from the registry.
accordion.q3Body: Only the small custom elements that need interactivity (tabs, dialog, dropdown, toast). Everything else is zero-JS.

dialog.description: Modal overlay built on the native <dialog> element. Trigger with [data-dialog-open=id], close with [data-dialog-close]. Click-outside-to-close handled by the registry script.
dialog.title: Delete project?
dialog.body: This action is permanent. All deployments, environments and analytics for this project will be removed.

dropdownMenu.description: Anchored menu using the native popover API + CSS anchor positioning. Wire a trigger by setting popovertarget to the menu id and anchor-name: --anchor on the trigger.

tooltip.description: Hover and focus contextual hint. Wraps any trigger and reveals content on pointer or keyboard focus. Side: top or bottom.

toast.description: Transient notifications. Drop a <Toaster /> once at the page root, then call toast(message, { variant }) from anywhere on the client.
toast.messageDestructive: Failed to reach the upstream server.

index.title: Blocks
index.description: Higher-level compositions built from the primitives.
index.intro: Composed blocks ready to drop in. Copy-paste with

summary.page-hero: Page heading composed of eyebrow, title and lede.
summary.breadcrumb: Trail of links with separators marking the current page.
summary.release-pill: Inline pill announcing a release or version.
summary.command-block: Copyable terminal command with one-click clipboard.
summary.terminal-preview: Faux terminal frame with chrome bar, content slot and blinking caret.
summary.feature-grid: Bordered grid of numbered features with tag, title and body.
summary.post-list: Vertical list of blog post entries with date, author, excerpt and tags.
summary.prev-next-nav: Paired previous / next navigation links for article footers.
summary.author-card: Author bio block with avatar fallback and link affordance.
summary.project-card: Project preview card with status pill, patterned cover and chips.
summary.metadata-grid: Key / value metadata grid for case-study summaries.
summary.toc-rail: Sticky table of contents with scroll-spy highlighting.
summary.not-found-state: 404 / empty-state block with code, title and action slot.
summary.notice-banner: Inline notice with icon and four semantic variants.

page-hero.description: Composes an eyebrow label, an h1 title and a lede paragraph. Use as the top section of any content page.

breadcrumb.description: Renders a list of links with a current-page marker. Pass an items array of { label, href }.

release-pill.description: Inline pill with a pulsing dot, label and optional detail. Becomes a link when href is set.

command-block.description: Shows a terminal command with a prompt prefix and a Copy button that writes to the clipboard.

terminal-preview.description: Faux terminal with macOS-style chrome dots, a path label and zsh badge. Slot accepts pre-formatted lines; pass caret={false} to hide the blinking caret.

feature-grid.description: Three- or two-column grid of features. Each cell renders an optional index, an uppercase tag, a heading and a body line.

post-list.description: Vertical post list. Use <PostList> as the container, then drop <PostListItem> children with title, href, date, author, reading time, excerpt and tags.

prev-next-nav.description: Renders previous / next navigation cards in a 2-column grid. Either side can be omitted.

author-card.description: Author bio block. If src is omitted, initials fall back from the name. Pass href to make the whole card a link.

project-card.description: Project preview card with patterned cover, status pill, title, description and chip row. Becomes a link when href is set.

metadata-grid.description: Renders a key / value grid as a semantic dl > dt + dd structure. Defaults to 4 columns; collapses to 2 on narrow viewports.

toc-rail.description: Sticky table of contents. Pass an entries array of { id, label, depth }. Uses IntersectionObserver to mark the currently visible heading.

not-found-state.description: Centered 404 / empty state with an eyebrow code, headline, description and an actions slot for buttons.

notice-banner.description: Inline notice with icon and four variants: info, warning, success, danger. Slot accepts the message.
